The shot opens as the footage reaches its last moment, everything exactly where it was. The camera holds a static shot. Everything carries on exactly where the footage left off, and then everything begins to move in slow motion except one small dog. Nobody seems to find it strange. The shot ends as everyone settles back into what they were doing, as if nothing had happened.
